body: a squat, wide, hollow old tree stump monster, wider than tall, with dark brown weathered bark and deep vertical grain. The top of the stump is broken into many tall jagged wooden spikes and short branch stubs pointing upward like a splintered crown, the tallest ones in the middle. Round clusters of leaves grow around the top rim behind and between the spikes, mixed green and orange-yellow autumn colours, hanging over the sides of the stump. Patches of bright green moss cling to the lower trunk. At the base the trunk splits into thick gnarled roots that spread out along the ground in every direction like claws.
front: an angry face carved into the bark on the front: two narrow slanted glowing amber eyes under heavy brows, a broad wooden nose ridge, and a wide jagged snarling mouth of splintered wood
left: a pure profile from the viewer's left: the trunk reads as a wide column, the spike crown and the leaf clusters seen edge-on, the roots spreading toward and away from the viewer, no face visible
back: the plain back of the trunk: no face at all, only dark bark grain, moss patches, the spike crown and the leaf clusters seen from behind, and the roots spreading out
right: a pure profile from the viewer's right: the trunk reads as a wide column, the spike crown and the leaf clusters seen edge-on, the roots spreading toward and away from the viewer, no face visible
